content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":true,"reason":"Sells motors and motion control devices to OEMs in industrial, medical and aerospace markets, overlapping Allient's core, though instruments dilute the match."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Makes valves, pumps, composite panels and aerospace parts; no motors, drives or motion controls."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Distributes MRO supplies and test equipment; does not design or manufacture motion products."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Distributes electronic components and fasteners from stock; a reseller, not a motion equipment maker."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Makes welding and cutting products and consumables; a different technology and customer base."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Makes pumps, valves and seals for process plants; fluid handling, not motion control."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Makes pumps, valves, brake friction parts and connectors; no motor, drive or motion control business."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Distributes metalworking tools and industrial supplies; a catalog distributor, not a manufacturer."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Makes automotive steering and driveline systems sold to automakers; a vehicle component business, not motion products for equipment builders."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Makes switchgear, substations and motor control centers for power distribution; electrical infrastructure, not motion equipment."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Makes engines and generator sets for equipment makers; combustion power, not electric motion control."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Makes locks, hinges, hardware and metal castings; mechanical hardware, not motors or drives."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Makes custom foam, plastic and composite components for OEMs; different materials and no motion or electrical products."}]}
